setup-pstack.en: Configure which models pstack uses per role and at what reasoning budget, for this project only. Detects the models pi can run with their prices, proposes a cost-aware preset, and writes .pi/pstack-models.md, which the pstack extension injects into every prompt. Use for /skill:setup-pstack, "configure pstack models", "pstack budget", or changing pstack's model choices.
setup-pstack.zh: 只为当前项目配置 pstack 各角色的模型和推理预算。检测 pi 能跑的模型及价格，给出兼顾成本的预设，写入 .pi/pstack-models.md，由 pstack 扩展注入每条提示词。用于 /setup-pstack、"configure pstack models"、"pstack budget"，或要改 pstack 的模型选择时。
